ayahs.arabic: وَٱلطُّورِ
ayahs.translit: Waalttoori

t.eng-ummmuhammad: By the mount

ayahs.arabic: وَكِتَٰبࣲ مَّسۡطُورࣲ‏
ayahs.translit: Wakitabin mastoorin

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And [by] a Book inscribed

ayahs.arabic: فِي رَقࣲّ مَّنشُورࣲ‏
ayahs.translit: Fee raqqin manshoorin

t.eng-ummmuhammad: In parchment spread open

ayahs.arabic: وَٱلۡبَيۡتِ ٱلۡمَعۡمُورِ
ayahs.translit: Waalbayti almaAAmoori

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And [by] the frequented House

ayahs.arabic: وَٱلسَّقۡفِ ٱلۡمَرۡفُوعِ
ayahs.translit: Waalssaqfi almarfooAAi

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And [by] the heaven raised high

ayahs.arabic: وَٱلۡبَحۡرِ ٱلۡمَسۡجُورِ
ayahs.translit: Waalbahri almasjoori

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And [by] the sea filled [with fire]

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّ عَذَابَ رَبِّكَ لَوَٰقِعࣱ‏
ayahs.translit: Inna AAathaba rabbika lawaqiAAun

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Indeed, the punishment of your Lord will occur

ayahs.arabic: مَّا لَهُۥ مِن دَافِعࣲ‏
ayahs.translit: Ma lahu min dafiAAin

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Of it there is no preventer

ayahs.arabic: يَوۡمَ تَمُورُ ٱلسَّمَآءُ مَوۡرࣰ ا
ayahs.translit: Yawma tamooru alssamao mawran

t.eng-ummmuhammad: On the Day the heaven will sway with circular motion

ayahs.arabic: وَتَسِيرُ ٱلۡجِبَالُ سَيۡرࣰ ا
ayahs.translit: Wataseeru aljibalu sayran

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And the mountains will pass on, departing

ayahs.arabic: فَوَيۡلࣱ يَوۡمَئِذࣲ لِّلۡمُكَذِّبِينَ
ayahs.translit: Fawaylun yawmaithin lilmukaththibeena

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Then woe, that Day, to the deniers

ayahs.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ هُمۡ فِي خَوۡضࣲ يَلۡعَبُونَ
ayahs.translit: Allatheena hum fee khawdin yalAAaboona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Who are in [empty] discourse amusing themselves

ayahs.arabic: يَوۡمَ يُدَعُّونَ إِلَىٰ نَارِ جَهَنَّمَ دَعًّا
ayahs.translit: Yawma yudaAAAAoona ila nari jahannama daAAAAan

t.eng-ummmuhammad: The Day they are thrust toward the fire of Hell with a [violent] thrust, [its angels will say]

ayahs.arabic: هَٰذِهِ ٱلنَّارُ ٱلَّتِي كُنتُم بِهَا تُكَذِّبُونَ
ayahs.translit: Hathihi alnnaru allatee kuntum biha tukaththiboona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: This is the Fire which you used to deny

ayahs.arabic: أَفَسِحۡرٌ هَٰذَآ أَمۡ أَنتُمۡ لَا تُبۡصِرُونَ
ayahs.translit: Afasihrun hatha am antum la tubsiroona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Then is this magic, or do you not see

ayahs.arabic: ٱصۡلَوۡهَا فَٱصۡبِرُوٓاْ أَوۡ لَا تَصۡبِرُواْ سَوَآءٌ عَلَيۡكُمۡۖ إِنَّمَا تُجۡزَوۡنَ مَا كُنتُمۡ تَعۡمَلُونَ
ayahs.translit: Islawha faisbiroo aw la tasbiroo sawaon AAalaykum innama tujzawna ma kuntum taAAmaloona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: [Enter to] burn therein; then be patient or impatient - it is all the same for you. You are only being recompensed [for] what you used to do

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلۡمُتَّقِينَ فِي جَنَّٰتࣲ وَنَعِيمࣲ‏
ayahs.translit: Inna almuttaqeena fee jannatin wanaAAeemin

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Indeed, the righteous will be in gardens and pleasure

ayahs.arabic: فَٰكِهِينَ بِمَآ ءَاتَىٰهُمۡ رَبُّهُمۡ وَوَقَىٰهُمۡ رَبُّهُمۡ عَذَابَ ٱلۡجَحِيمِ
ayahs.translit: Fakiheena bima atahum rabbuhum wawaqahum rabbuhum AAathaba aljaheemi

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Enjoying what their Lord has given them, and their Lord protected them from the punishment of Hellfire

ayahs.arabic: كُلُواْ وَٱشۡرَبُواْ هَنِيٓـَٔۢا بِمَا كُنتُمۡ تَعۡمَلُونَ
ayahs.translit: Kuloo waishraboo haneean bima kuntum taAAmaloona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: [They will be told], "Eat and drink in satisfaction for what you used to do

ayahs.arabic: مُتَّكِـِٔينَ عَلَىٰ سُرُرࣲ مَّصۡفُوفَةࣲۖ وَزَوَّجۡنَٰهُم بِحُورٍ عِينࣲ‏
ayahs.translit: Muttakieena AAala sururin masfoofatin wazawwajnahum bihoorin AAeenin

t.eng-ummmuhammad: They will be reclining on thrones lined up, and We will marry them to fair women with large, [beautiful] eyes

ayahs.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَٱتَّبَعَتۡهُمۡ ذُرِّيَّتُهُم بِإِيمَٰنٍ أَلۡحَقۡنَا بِهِمۡ ذُرِّيَّتَهُمۡ وَمَآ أَلَتۡنَٰهُم مِّنۡ عَمَلِهِم مِّن شَيۡءࣲۚ كُلُّ ٱمۡرِيِٕۭ بِمَا كَسَبَ رَهِينࣱ‏
ayahs.translit: Waallatheena amanoo waittabaAAathum thurriyyatuhum bieemanin alhaqna bihim thurriyyatahum wama alatnahum min AAamalihim min shayin kullu imriin bima kasaba raheenun

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And those who believed and whose descendants followed them in faith - We will join with them their descendants, and We will not deprive them of anything of their deeds. Every person, for what he earned, is retained

ayahs.arabic: وَأَمۡدَدۡنَٰهُم بِفَٰكِهَةࣲ وَلَحۡمࣲ مِّمَّا يَشۡتَهُونَ
ayahs.translit: Waamdadnahum bifakihatin walahmin mimma yashtahoona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And We will provide them with fruit and meat from whatever they desire

ayahs.arabic: يَتَنَٰزَعُونَ فِيهَا كَأۡسࣰ ا لَّا لَغۡوࣱ فِيهَا وَلَا تَأۡثِيمࣱ‏
ayahs.translit: YatanazaAAoona feeha kasan la laghwun feeha wala tatheemun

t.eng-ummmuhammad: They will exchange with one another a cup [of wine] wherein [results] no ill speech or commission of sin

ayahs.arabic: ۞وَيَطُوفُ عَلَيۡهِمۡ غِلۡمَانࣱ لَّهُمۡ كَأَنَّهُمۡ لُؤۡلُؤࣱ مَّكۡنُونࣱ‏
ayahs.translit: Wayatoofu AAalayhim ghilmanun lahum kaannahum luluon maknoonun

t.eng-ummmuhammad: There will circulate among them [servant] boys [especially] for them, as if they were pearls well-protected

ayahs.arabic: وَأَقۡبَلَ بَعۡضُهُمۡ عَلَىٰ بَعۡضࣲ يَتَسَآءَلُونَ
ayahs.translit: Waaqbala baAAduhum AAala baAAdin yatasaaloona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And they will approach one another, inquiring of each other

ayahs.arabic: قَالُوٓاْ إِنَّا كُنَّا قَبۡلُ فِيٓ أَهۡلِنَا مُشۡفِقِينَ
ayahs.translit: Qaloo inna kunna qablu fee ahlina mushfiqeena

t.eng-ummmuhammad: They will say, "Indeed, we were previously among our people fearful [of displeasing Allah]

ayahs.arabic: فَمَنَّ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيۡنَا وَوَقَىٰنَا عَذَابَ ٱلسَّمُومِ
ayahs.translit: Famanna Allahu AAalayna wawaqana AAathaba alssamoomi

t.eng-ummmuhammad: So Allah conferred favor upon us and protected us from the punishment of the Scorching Fire

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّا كُنَّا مِن قَبۡلُ نَدۡعُوهُۖ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلۡبَرُّ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
ayahs.translit: Inna kunna min qablu nadAAoohu innahu huwa albarru alrraheemu

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Indeed, we used to supplicate Him before. Indeed, it is He who is the Beneficent, the Merciful

ayahs.arabic: فَذَكِّرۡ فَمَآ أَنتَ بِنِعۡمَتِ رَبِّكَ بِكَاهِنࣲ وَلَا مَجۡنُونٍ
ayahs.translit: Fathakkir fama anta biniAAmati rabbika bikahin wala majnoonin

t.eng-ummmuhammad: So remind [O Muhammad], for you are not, by the favor of your Lord, a soothsayer or a madman

ayahs.arabic: أَمۡ يَقُولُونَ شَاعِرࣱ نَّتَرَبَّصُ بِهِۦ رَيۡبَ ٱلۡمَنُونِ
ayahs.translit: Am yaqooloona shaAAirun natarabbasu bihi rayba almanooni

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Or do they say [of you], "A poet for whom we await a misfortune of time

ayahs.arabic: قُلۡ تَرَبَّصُواْ فَإِنِّي مَعَكُم مِّنَ ٱلۡمُتَرَبِّصِينَ
ayahs.translit: Qul tarabbasoo fainnee maAAakum mina almutarabbiseena

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Say, "Wait, for indeed I am, with you, among the waiters

ayahs.arabic: أَمۡ تَأۡمُرُهُمۡ أَحۡلَٰمُهُم بِهَٰذَآۚ أَمۡ هُمۡ قَوۡمࣱ طَاغُونَ
ayahs.translit: Am tamuruhum ahlamuhum bihatha am hum qawmun taghoona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Or do their minds command them to [say] this, or are they a transgressing people

ayahs.arabic: أَمۡ يَقُولُونَ تَقَوَّلَهُۥۚ بَل لَّا يُؤۡمِنُونَ
ayahs.translit: Am yaqooloona taqawwalahu bal la yuminoona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Or do they say, "He has made it up"? Rather, they do not believe

ayahs.arabic: فَلۡيَأۡتُواْ بِحَدِيثࣲ مِّثۡلِهِۦٓ إِن كَانُواْ صَٰدِقِينَ
ayahs.translit: Falyatoo bihadeethin mithlihi in kanoo sadiqeena

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Then let them produce a statement like it, if they should be truthful

ayahs.arabic: أَمۡ خُلِقُواْ مِنۡ غَيۡرِ شَيۡءٍ أَمۡ هُمُ ٱلۡخَٰلِقُونَ
ayahs.translit: Am khuliqoo min ghayri shayin am humu alkhaliqoona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Or were they created by nothing, or were they the creators [of themselves]

ayahs.arabic: أَمۡ خَلَقُواْ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضَۚ بَل لَّا يُوقِنُونَ
ayahs.translit: Am khalaqoo alssamawati waalarda bal la yooqinoona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Or did they create the heavens and the earth? Rather, they are not certain

ayahs.arabic: أَمۡ عِندَهُمۡ خَزَآئِنُ رَبِّكَ أَمۡ هُمُ ٱلۡمُصَۜيۡطِرُونَ
ayahs.translit: Am AAindahum khazainu rabbika am humu almusaytiroona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Or have they the depositories [containing the provision] of your Lord? Or are they the controllers [of them]

ayahs.arabic: أَمۡ لَهُمۡ سُلَّمࣱ يَسۡتَمِعُونَ فِيهِۖ فَلۡيَأۡتِ مُسۡتَمِعُهُم بِسُلۡطَٰنࣲ مُّبِينٍ
ayahs.translit: Am lahum sullamun yastamiAAoona feehi falyati mustamiAAuhum bisultanin mubeenin

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Or have they a stairway [into the heaven] upon which they listen? Then let their listener produce a clear authority

ayahs.arabic: أَمۡ لَهُ ٱلۡبَنَٰتُ وَلَكُمُ ٱلۡبَنُونَ
ayahs.translit: Am lahu albanatu walakumu albanoona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Or has He daughters while you have sons

ayahs.arabic: أَمۡ تَسۡـَٔلُهُمۡ أَجۡرࣰ ا فَهُم مِّن مَّغۡرَمࣲ مُّثۡقَلُونَ
ayahs.translit: Am tasaluhum ajran fahum min maghramin muthqaloona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Or do you, [O Muhammad], ask of them a payment, so they are by debt burdened down

ayahs.arabic: أَمۡ عِندَهُمُ ٱلۡغَيۡبُ فَهُمۡ يَكۡتُبُونَ
ayahs.translit: Am AAindahumu alghaybu fahum yaktuboona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Or have they [knowledge of] the unseen, so they write [it] down

ayahs.arabic: أَمۡ يُرِيدُونَ كَيۡدࣰ اۖ فَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ هُمُ ٱلۡمَكِيدُونَ
ayahs.translit: Am yureedoona kaydan faallatheena kafaroo humu almakeedoona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Or do they intend a plan? But those who disbelieve - they are the object of a plan

ayahs.arabic: أَمۡ لَهُمۡ إِلَٰهٌ غَيۡرُ ٱللَّهِۚ سُبۡحَٰنَ ٱللَّهِ عَمَّا يُشۡرِكُونَ
ayahs.translit: Am lahum ilahun ghayru Allahi subhana Allahi AAamma yushrikoona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Or have they a deity other than Allah? Exalted is Allah above whatever they associate with Him

ayahs.arabic: وَإِن يَرَوۡاْ كِسۡفࣰ ا مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ سَاقِطࣰ ا يَقُولُواْ سَحَابࣱ مَّرۡكُومࣱ‏
ayahs.translit: Wain yaraw kisfan mina alssamai saqitan yaqooloo sahabun markoomun

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And if they were to see a fragment from the sky falling, they would say, "[It is merely] clouds heaped up

ayahs.arabic: فَذَرۡهُمۡ حَتَّىٰ يُلَٰقُواْ يَوۡمَهُمُ ٱلَّذِي فِيهِ يُصۡعَقُونَ
ayahs.translit: Fatharhum hatta yulaqoo yawmahumu allathee feehi yusAAaqoona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: So leave them until they meet their Day in which they will be struck insensible

ayahs.arabic: يَوۡمَ لَا يُغۡنِي عَنۡهُمۡ كَيۡدُهُمۡ شَيۡـࣰٔ ا وَلَا هُمۡ يُنصَرُونَ
ayahs.translit: Yawma la yughnee AAanhum kayduhum shayan wala hum yunsaroona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: The Day their plan will not avail them at all, nor will they be helped

ayahs.arabic: وَإِنَّ لِلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُواْ عَذَابࣰ ا دُونَ ذَٰلِكَ وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكۡثَرَهُمۡ لَا يَعۡلَمُونَ
ayahs.translit: Wainna lillatheena thalamoo AAathaban doona thalika walakinna aktharahum la yaAAlamoona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And indeed, for those who have wronged is a punishment before that, but most of them do not know

ayahs.arabic: وَٱصۡبِرۡ لِحُكۡمِ رَبِّكَ فَإِنَّكَ بِأَعۡيُنِنَاۖ وَسَبِّحۡ بِحَمۡدِ رَبِّكَ حِينَ تَقُومُ
ayahs.translit: Waisbir lihukmi rabbika fainnaka biaAAyunina wasabbih bihamdi rabbika heena taqoomu

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And be patient, [O Muhammad], for the decision of your Lord, for indeed, you are in Our eyes. And exalt [Allah] with praise of your Lord when you arise

ayahs.arabic: وَمِنَ ٱلَّيۡلِ فَسَبِّحۡهُ وَإِدۡبَٰرَ ٱلنُّجُومِ
ayahs.translit: Wamina allayli fasabbihhu waidbara alnnujoomi

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And in a part of the night exalt Him and after [the setting of] the stars
